Subject: Security intake: pen-test report access, scanning cadence & disclosure plan

Hi Olivia / Tom — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have alignment on next steps: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm the most recent Type II report date and whether you have a public report or an auditor letter we can consume?
- Pen test: Redwood needs either a redacted pen-test report or the ability to receive it under NDA. Please advise preferred method and an approximate delivery date.
- Vulnerability cadence / SLA: on our side we typically expect quarterly authenticated scans and an annual third-party pentest; for discovered vulnerabilities we ask for vendor triage within 72 hours and mitigation/mitigation plan for critical findings within 30 days. Are those acceptable?
- Vendor security questionnaire: I’ve attached our questionnaire (short form) — please return with your answers or nominate a security contact to coordinate.

If you can provide: SOC2 date, contact for security exchange, and whether you can produce a redacted pen test or want an NDA route, we’ll route this to our security team and send the intake template.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an internal handoff to security once we have the basics.

Best,
Priyom Das

- SOC 2: most recent Type II report completed 2026-02-10 (we can share a redacted report).
- Pen test: we have a third-party pen test from 2025-11-05. We can provide a redacted copy; if Redwood needs original we can do an NDA + secure transfer.
- Scans / SLA: we run monthly authenticated scans for production and quarterly external scans. For critical issues we aim for a fix or documented mitigation within 30 days — triage within 48-72 hours.

Hi Olivia / team — thanks for the quick replies. I’m Neha from Redwood Security; I’ll manage the intake. A few clarifying items and next steps: 

1) Exchange mechanism: we prefer either a redacted PDF delivered via SFTP or a signed bilateral NDA + secure file transfer. If SFTP is easier, please provide a short-lived account or an upload path (we can also accept a presigned S3 link).

2) Scope & evidence: please confirm the scope of the 2025 pen test (prod only? subdomains? customer-data systems?). We need a short scope statement and a list of CVEs/Finding IDs in the redacted report (redaction ok for customer data).

3) SLA expectations: Redwood’s intake template requests triage within 72 hours and mitigation plan for critical findings within 30 days. If your internal SLA is 48-72 hours, that aligns; we’ll record the mutual SLA in the intake.

4) Disclosure policy: do you have a coordinated disclosure contact and embargo window for public write-ups? We ask partners not to publish exploit details before mutual remediation.

I’ve attached two stubs: our vendor questionnaire (short) and a pen test receipt template that we use to track exchange + attestations. Please return the questionnaire and a preferred transfer method.

Also tagging the deal record: HubSpot link below so we can attach artifacts. Once we receive the redacted report + scope we’ll create a secure evidence folder and mark the deal as security-cleared for onboarding.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
